towns.name: Hebian-to
towns.summary: Hebian-To, the first Sho settlement and capital of the Sho lands, stands on a 32 m bluff at the mouth of the River Prosper, where the river (running water along y 15200-15240) turns north into a shallow bay. Its plaza is ringed by green-roofed halls, dome houses and octagon pavilions and crowned by the West Wind Tower, a 31 m octagon pagoda, with the Town Network portal, a Life Stone, a well and the nullified statue of Ben Ten on its pedestal, all lined with flame lanterns. Down on the river terrace to the west stands the Sho Library, where Fanzen San translates the Falatacot texts, with its own Life Stone; the Celestial Hand keeps its stronghold, hung with glowing golden banners, at the south-east edge, and the Advocate and Sentinel statues stand on the hill beyond.
